name: openspec_status
description: Report OpenSpec artifact completion status for a change (openspec status --json): applyRequires, per-artifact status/missingDeps.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repo containing the OpenSpec change.

changeName.description: OpenSpec change id to report status for (openspec status --change <changeName> --json).
The OpenSpec change id this status is for.

schemaName.description: Name of the OpenSpec schema the change was created under.

changeRoot.description: Absolute path to the change's directory.

isComplete.description: True when every artifact required by the schema's apply phase is done.

applyRequires.description: Artifact ids the apply phase requires to be complete, from the schema's `apply.requires` (or every artifact id if unset).

artifacts.description: Per-artifact completion status, ordered by build order.

outputPath.description: Artifact's output path relative to the change directory.

missingDeps.description: Dependency artifact ids still missing, present only when status is 'blocked'.

artifactPaths.description: Map of artifact id to its output/resolved/existing path details, as returned by the OpenSpec CLI.

nextSteps.description: Human-oriented next-action guidance for the change, as returned by the OpenSpec CLI.

actionContext.description: Machine-oriented action context for the change, as returned by the OpenSpec CLI.

planningHome.description: Summary of the resolved OpenSpec planning home, as returned by the OpenSpec CLI.

root.description: Resolved OpenSpec root descriptor, as returned by the OpenSpec CLI.
